fact: 1921年5月5日，协约国向德国发出伦敦最后通牒（London Ultimatum），要求德国在六天内无条件接受赔款总额1320亿金马克（分30年偿付，每年20亿金马克加出口值的26%），否则将占领鲁尔。费伦巴赫内阁于5月4日辞职，新任总理维尔特（中央党）在帝国议会勉强通过接受通牒的投票。

sources.title: Encyclopædia Britannica, Weimar Republic: Years of crisis (1920–23)
sources.quote: On April 27, 1921, the Allied reparation commission fixed the total to be paid by Germany at 132 billion gold marks. Regarding this as far in excess of the country's capacity to pay, the Fehrenbach government resigned on May 4. The Allies retorted with an ultimatum calling on Germany to announce its unconditional acceptance of the figure within six days, under threat of the occupation of the Ruhr. ... Karl Joseph Wirth (Centre), the new chancellor of another 'Weimar coalition,' secured a reluctant vote from the Reichstag in favor of accepting.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Inflation in the Weimar Republic
sources.quote: The 'London ultimatum' in May 1921 demanded reparations in gold to be paid in annual installments of 2,000,000,000 gold marks plus 26 percent of the value of Germany's exports. The first payment was paid when due in August 1921.

fact: 1921年上半年马克对美元汇率相对稳定在约60马克兑1美元（一说90马克兑1美元）。伦敦最后通牒后，1921年8月起德国开始不计代价地以马克购买外汇支付赔款，加速马克贬值。到1921年11月，马克跌至约330马克兑1美元（不到1美分的三分之一），半年内贬值约5倍。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Inflation in the Weimar Republic
sources.quote: The German currency was relatively stable at about 60 Marks per US Dollar during the first half of 1921. ... The first payment was paid when due in August 1921. That was the beginning of an increasingly rapid devaluation of the Mark which fell to less than one third of a cent by November 1921 (approx. 330 Marks per US Dollar).

sources.title: 中文维基镜像，威玛共和国恶性通货膨胀
sources.quote: 1921年上半年,馬克匯率穩定在1美元可以兌換90馬克。……1921年8月起,德國開始大量印鈔購買外匯,進而引發馬克急劇貶值。

fact: 1921年3月20日，上西里西亚举行公民投票，多数居民选择留在德国。波兰随后组织武装起义试图以武力夺取领土，法国支持波兰。争端提交国际联盟，国联裁定将三分之二领土判给德国，但主要煤矿区和大量德国居民留在波兰一侧。此决定在德国引发强烈不满。

sources.title: Encyclopædia Britannica, Weimar Republic: Years of crisis (1920–23)
sources.quote: In the plebiscite held in Upper Silesia on March 20, 1921, an overall majority voted to remain with Germany. ... Poland retaliated by organizing an armed revolt and attempting to seize territory by force. ... The League awarded two-thirds of the territory to Germany but left the coal mines, the principal industrial areas, and a considerable German minority on the Polish side of the frontier. The decision was hotly resented in Germany.

fact: 1921年3月，德国中部曼斯费尔德矿区矿工武装起义反对警察，德国共产党号召总罢工未果，秩序迅速恢复。此次「三月行动」（Märzaktion）由共产国际代表贝拉·库恩等推动，但未能获得广泛工人支持，遭到失败。德国社会民主党和工会运动成为抵御苏俄式革命的有效屏障。

sources.title: Encyclopædia Britannica, Weimar Republic: Years of crisis (1920–23)
sources.quote: When miners in the Mansfeld district of central Germany took up arms against the police in March 1921, the Communists unsuccessfully called for a general strike, and order was rapidly restored. However, there was still widespread fear of a German revolution on the Soviet model. Against this, the powerful and moderate Social Democratic Party and the trade union movement proved an effective barrier.

fact: 1921年维尔特-拉特瑙政府推行「履约政策」（Erfüllungspolitik）：表面上遵守协约国要求以争取时间。8月与美国签订单独和平条约，与苏俄建立经济和军事联系（为1922年拉巴洛条约铺路），并与法国展开双边经济谈判（威斯巴登协议）。拉特瑙任重建部长，成为魏玛外交的核心人物。

sources.title: German Revisionpolitik, 1919-1933（Historical Papers/Erudit）
sources.quote: Together they introduced a new, more active phase of Weimar diplomacy: Erfüllungspolitik. Based on outward compliance with the Allied demands... Germany signed a separate peace treaty with the United States in August 1921, established economic and military ties with Soviet Russia... The Wirth-Rathenau government also resumed bilateral economic negotiations with France (culminating in the innocuous Wiesbaden agreement).

fact: 1921年德国生活成本随马克贬值持续攀升。物价指数（1914=100）从1921年初的约1400升至年底的约3700。工人通过集体谈判不断追涨工资，但「通常落后物价一两步」。1921年6月生活成本指数为41（以1922年某基准计），到1922年6月升至41——说明1921年下半年已开始加速。房租受管制（新住房租金不受严格管制），住房严重短缺。

sources.title: Mises Institute, Business Regulation under Inflation
sources.quote: For almost the whole of the inflation period the workers were thus engaged in a constant struggle to increase wages in order merely to keep pace with the ever-renewed spurts in prices and, in spite of the elaborate machinery of adjustment which was developed, they were usually a lap or two behind. ... Rentals on new houses were not strictly controlled but the generally low rate of wages made it impossible for workers to pay the rent necessary to yield any reasonable return on the cost of building new dwellings. A marked shortage of housing was the inevitable result.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Inflation in the Weimar Republic
sources.quote: The cost of living index was 41 in June 1922 and 685 in December, an increase of more than 16 times.

fact: 1921年马克购买力急剧缩水：以美元计价，马克从年初约60—90马克/美元贬至11月约330马克/美元。固定收入者（公务员、学者、律师、靠利息生活的中产阶级）遭受毁灭性打击——「Bildungsbürgertum」（知识中产阶级）的固定利率投资被通胀抹去。债务人和外汇操作者则受益。

sources.title: The National, Money to burn（书评）
sources.quote: Between October 1921 and December 1923, the mark to the dollar rate zoomed from 150.20 to 4,200,000,000,000. There were winners and losers in such economic conditions. Debtors faired quite well, as did anyone who played the foreign currency markets. Savers and creditors faired poorly. The stratum of the educated bourgeois classes – academics, lawyers, civil servants – known as the Bildungsbürgertum – was devastated by hyperinflation.

fact: 1921年德国处于魏玛共和国法治框架下，但赔款压力迫使政府通过大量紧急法令。1921年上半年价格管制（Preiskontrolle）仍然有效，但年底基本放弃（「general policy of control was abandoned at the end of 1921」）。非法贸易以远高于官方价格的水平盛行。外汇管制逐步加强，走私猖獗。

sources.title: Mises Institute, Business Regulation under Inflation
sources.quote: The general policy of control was abandoned at the end of 1921 and only sporadic action was taken thereafter. Illicit trading at prices markedly higher than the official quotations was always rife. ... Smuggling was widely prevalent and many companies sprang up in Holland offering insurance against seizure.

fact: 1921年德国货币供应量急剧膨胀：帝国银行货币基础从1921年初的约60亿马克增至1922年中的逾3000亿马克（12个月内增长5000%）。1921年8月起德国不计代价购买外汇支付赔款，形成「马克越贬、所需马克越多」的恶性循环。1921年是魏玛通胀从高位通胀转向恶性通胀的过渡年。

sources.title: Finexus, The Weimar Hyperinflation (1921-1923)
sources.quote: expanding the monetary base from 6 billion marks in early 1921 to over 300 billion by mid-1922 – a 5,000% increase in twelve months. ... Beginning in August 1921, Germany began to buy foreign currency with Marks at any price, but that only increased the speed of breakdown in the value of the Mark.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Inflation in the Weimar Republic
sources.quote: Beginning in August 1921, Germany began to buy foreign currency with Marks at any price, but that only increased the speed of breakdown in the value of the Mark. The lower the mark sank in international markets, the greater the amount of marks were required to buy the foreign currency demanded by the Reparations Commission.

fact: 1921年德国工业加速集中与卡特尔化。胡戈·施廷内斯（Hugo Stinnes）通过垂直整合构建德国历史上最大的商业帝国：从煤矿起家，扩展到航运、钢铁、造纸、电气、酒店和报纸（1922年拥有60余家报纸）。1920年施廷内斯推动Deutsch-Luxemburg与Gelsenkirchener Bergwerks合并为Rheinelbe Union，并与西门子联合成立Siemens-Rheinelbe-Schuckert-Union（资本6.15亿马克）。通胀使得「资产几乎可以白捡」。

sources.title: Encyclopedia.com, Stinnes AG
sources.quote: Helping this process of acquisition was the cataclysmic German inflation of the early 1920s; property could be bought for almost nothing. At the time of his premature death in 1924, not only was Hugo Stinnes Germany's most influential and powerful industrialist, but he was also the owner of the largest firm (in terms of assets and revenues) in the country. Hugo Stinnes GmbH consisted of more than 4,500 businesses.

sources.title: Mises Institute, Business Regulation under Inflation
sources.quote: The dominant personality in the whole movement was Hugo Stinnes, and his greatest concern, the Siemens-Schuckert-Rhein-Elbe-Union. In this group were gathered enormous shipping, mining, iron and steel, and electrical enterprises. Stinnes acquired... is said at one time to have controlled the employment of 600,000 workers.

fact: 1921年德国化学工业卡特尔化进程加速。化学卡特尔开始向煤炭行业垂直整合：收购煤矿和炼焦厂，将焦炉改造为可即时提炼副产品的装置，开展干馏和氢化实验，开始销售萘、蒽、杂酚油、沥青等煤焦油产品。到1933年该卡特尔开采1640万吨煤炭。染料、合成氨、制药等产业链向纤维、化肥、炸药、医疗用品延伸。

sources.title: Journal of European Economic History, Cartelization of the German Chemical Industry, 1918-1925
sources.quote: The chemical cartel started its vertical acquisitions in the coal industries. ... The cartel purchased mine and refining plants. Coke ovens were converted so that the by-products could be refined immediately and with less expense. ... This trend continued until, by 1933, the cartel mined 16.4 million tons of coal.

fact: 1921年德国劳动力市场受通胀扭曲：工人为追上物价持续涨薪，但「通常落后一两步」。名义工资快速上升但实际购买力下降。有组织的工会通过指数化调整机制保护会员，但无组织的白领和固定收入者首当其冲。住房短缺严重，新住房投资因租金管制而无利可图。

sources.title: Mises Institute, Business Regulation under Inflation
sources.quote: For almost the whole of the inflation period the workers were thus engaged in a constant struggle to increase wages in order merely to keep pace with the ever-renewed spurts in prices and, in spite of the elaborate machinery of adjustment which was developed, they were usually a lap or two behind. ... A marked shortage of housing was the inevitable result.
